interpretation.volatility: Latest-bar information gain replicated; memory adds less than0.5%; QLIKE does not beat CEJS. No substantial matched-memory advance.
interpretation.sparse_v5: Rejected: fixed global hazard worsens stationary error; budget9 fails recurrence, budget32 remains worse than v3. v6/v7 follow-ups completed separately.
interpretation.returns_v5: Search-floor result prompted v6 refinement. Completed v6 selects zero auxiliary weight; auxiliary teaching did not improve return prediction.
interpretation.sparse_v6_development: Hazard uncertainty improves development stationary MSE7.68% and one-change4.25% versus v3, but worsens recurrence15.99%. The completed fresh confirmation rejects promotion.
interpretation.returns_v6_development: Expanded search selected interior learning rates; both auxiliary families selected weight0. Matched memory Adam raw MSE is0.99981653 of zero. Auxiliary transfer hypothesis failed this selection, not a positive architecture result.
interpretation.sparse_v6_confirmation: Reject promotion: stationary gain2.97%, single-change full-stream gain3.43%, recurrence regression29.15%, two-support regression1.22%; null1.5916e-5 exceeds1e-5 guard. All60000 samples consumed; these results do not alter predeclared v7 designs.
interpretation.returns_v6_confirmation: Memory Adam raw MSE0.99935218 of zero,0.06478% lower, and wins all3 observed blocks. Latest Adam0.99935098. Tested auxiliary remains disabled by prefix selection and is worse than matched memory Adam. A tiny measured edge, not the1% target or profitability; no iid significance claim.
interpretation.sparse_v7_confirmation: Reject promotion: fresh stationary -9.03%, change -4.84%, recurrence +25.42%, two-support -1.55% versus v3. Null passes absolute guard but is7.34x v3. Development changes do not establish a general advance.
interpretation.return_hierarchy_v7: Reject: raw MSE/zero is1.02765 in development,1.01158 on reused rank400 and2283.778 on additional rank600. All candidates remain finite and independent end-state coefficient audits agree; numerical agreement does not validate the statistical model. Hierarchy null ratio1.01835. Memory Adam remains belowzero but gains only0.12546% on rank600.

caveats: Upper-bound priors selected for independent and hierarchical families; no impossibility claim.

Unclipped lag-specific unit-RMS features differ from clipped neural features. Completed development diagnostic finds extreme feature magnitudes and concentrated prediction energy; causation is not established.

return_hierarchy_v7_diagnostic.interpretation: The255 development samples with at least one absolute feature above1000 account for79.65% of hierarchy raw prediction energy and99.995% of independent-ridge energy. This is an association, not formal posterior leverage or proof of the cause of rank600 failure.

completion.significance: No seed-level significance, equal-compute, PPO or profitability claim.
completion.promotion: No new sparse or signed-return strategy promoted; volatility gain is largely newer information.

research_conclusion.abstract_target: Causal conditional mean E[y_t | x_t,H_t] under disclosed information and compute constraints; not a claim of reaching the global optimum.
research_conclusion.brain_inspiration: Context memory, shared representations and uncertainty are hypotheses evaluated by forward predictions, not biological explanations of success.
retained_findings: Latest-bar information materially improves volatility prediction.
Causal memory adds less than0.5% beyond the same latest-frame volatility head.
Memory Adam raw-return MSE improves0.0648% on the earlier rank400 confirmation and0.1255% on the additional rank600 cohort.
rejected_findings: Sparse segment/hazard/structure methods do not meet the all-view confirmation target.
Shared volatility auxiliary loss selects weightzero in direct-return prediction.
Static hierarchical Gaussian return inference catastrophically fails additional-cohort raw MSE despite agreeing with its declared posterior.
unproven_explanations: Recurring-context retrieval rather than retained segment histories may be needed for recurrence.
Lag/forecast scale mismatch and underestimated observation uncertainty may contribute to extreme return forecasts; development magnitude bins are associational only.

posthoc_selection_check.interpretation: Raw-prefix selection did not improve the already-inspected development suffix versus normalized-prefix-selected memory Adam. No new learner or confirmation was run for this posthoc selector.
